title: The Art of Balance
subtitle: Sami & Mina are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🦷✨

Sami is an impatient dentist: 'A malocclusion? Let's extract the premolars, it's sorted in 2 months!' Mina, an expert in orthodontics, corrects him: 'Not so fast, Sami! Orthodontics is much more than just extractions.'

Between a Class II with severe overjet, an impacted canine, an anterior open bite, or facial asymmetry, orthodontics is a true art.

An incomplete diagnosis, a poorly designed treatment plan, and the patient loses teeth or stability. A rigorous planning, a personalized approach, and the patient regains smile and function.

Facial balance, masticatory function, stability of results rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Sami is impatient: 'A malocclusion? Let's extract the premolars!' Mina corrects him: 'Not so fast!' Discover the basics of orthodontics: Angle's classification, cephalometry, growth, crowding.
chapters.debutant2: Sami and Mina delve into orthodontic therapies: functional appliances, braces, aligners, mini-screws, surgery. They discover that each case is unique.
chapters.intermediaire1: Sami and Mina master orthodontic diagnosis: classification, cephalometry, Bolton analysis, growth. They learn to precisely evaluate each patient.
chapters.intermediaire2: Sami and Mina tackle orthodontic therapies: functional appliances, braces, aligners, mini-screws, surgery. Orthodontics is put to the test.
chapters.expert1: Sami and Mina become references in orthodontics. They train young dentists on the importance of diagnosis and planning.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice, Sami and Mina leave a legacy of orthodontic skills. Orthodontics is the art of balance.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Sami understood that orthodontics is more complex than a simple extraction. Mina is proud of him.
chapterEndings.debutant2: Sami and Mina master orthodontic therapies. They are ready for more complex cases.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Mastery of orthodontic diagnosis is acquired. Sami and Mina are experts.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Orthodontic therapies are mastered. Sami and Mina take on all challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Orthodontic strategy has become a philosophy. Sami and Mina train the next generation.
chapterEndings.expert2: Sami and Mina have accomplished their mission. Orthodontics is the art of balance.
